notes.title: 2.1.5 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced score given by most enemies and some items.
[*] Regular enemies no longer give score or items in boss rooms.
[*] Started a new high score leaderboard.
[*] Reduced the ridiculous score requirement of a few achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.4 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list][*]Increased the health the knight gains from pickups again from 33 to 50.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where weapons sometimes stopped dropping during boss fights.
[*]Fixed an issue where unpausing the game sometimes caused the wrong music track to play.
[*]With page up/down volume no longer goes to 101. (Insert This Is Spinal Tap reference here)[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

Water is considerably less dangerous now.
[list][*]Blue just slows you.
[*]Green slows and applies a short poison effect.
[*]Red slows and damages you directly, faster than green's poison.[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[*]Health pickups have new sprites to help differentiate them more from the mage's fireball spell pickup.
[*]Centered the player's block overlap instead of it being more on the top and none on the bottom. This may be replaced with a better pathing system later.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]The mage's heal spell pickup no longer prevents all other spells from dropping during boss fights.[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[*]Made some tweaks that should improve performance significantly for some people.
[*]Added a temporary review plug for certain countries in hopes of pulling the game back up after a lot of complaints were addressed in the last patch.[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[*]Player movement is now fully analog. You can move in 8 directions on a keyboard or dpad but an analog stick feels better.
[*]Player movement speed has been reduced.
[*]Player hitboxes have been reduced.
[*]Weapon cycling has been replaced by 4 separate weapon buttons and an interface to match.
[*]The game can now be windowed by pressing Alt+Enter.
[*]Increased the game's internal resolution. This should make movement smoother.
[*]The startup logos now only display when you first start the game.
[*]Removed the controls screen since it's not really necessary anymore.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Save data wasn't loading properly for some people, instead showing "Undefined" in every field. Local high scores and such have been wiped for this change but not the leaderboard.
[*]Some people were having issues with screenshots only capturing the left half of the screen.
[*]Volume no longer reverts when unpaused if changed with page up/down while paused.

notes.title: 2.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[*]Completely re-wrote the save files using [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/597230/Shotgun_Legend]Shotgun Legend[/url]'s newer method. high scores and such have been reset in game for this one but the leaderboards remain.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[*]Corrected the lock up that occurred in the first shop of the second loop.[/list]
